name: Ama Koi Syrups ~Hajirau Koigokoro de Shitaku Naru Amagami-sama no Koi Matsuri~
original_name: あま恋シロップス ～恥じらう恋心でシたくなる甘神様の恋祭り～
source:
Sachikazu lives in Hoshikago city which holds a festival called Hoshiai (Meeting of the Stars) every Tanabata. One early summer day, he went with his childhood friend Tsuyuri to a small shrine on the rocky shore to make an offering of handmade sweets. There they met the strange round being Manjuu-sama. After being embraced by it, Tsuyuri’s face turned increasingly red and her breathing became heavier. He was about to help her, but was instead pushed down. It looked like she was sexually excited. She turned back to normal after he sprayed his semen on her. Then, a girl in a miko outfit, Hozumi, appeared before them and proclaimed that since Manjuu-sama had awakened, she will help make sure the “Hoshiai Ritual” is performed accordingly.

The only way to combat the sexual urges that are caused by Manjuu-sama’s mysterious ability is his semen! With his younger sister Rin and English transfer student Anastesia also dragged in, the festival of love has begun!

幸和居住在星籠市，這裡每年七夕都會舉辦名為「星合」（星星相會）的祭典。初夏的一天，他與青梅竹馬露里前往岩岸邊的小神社，供奉親手製作的點心。在那裡，他們遇見了奇怪的圓滾滾生物饅頭大人。它擁抱露里後，她的臉越來越紅，呼吸也變得急促。幸和正要幫助她，卻反被推倒。看起來，她似乎受到了性刺激。直到他將精液射在她身上，她才恢復正常。隨後，一名穿著巫女服的女孩穗積出現在他們面前，宣告饅頭大人已經覺醒，她會幫助他們按規矩完成「星合儀式」。

對抗饅頭大人神秘能力引發的性慾，唯一的辦法就是他的精液！隨著妹妹鈴和英國轉學生阿納斯塔西婭也被捲入，愛的祭典開始了！
